messages:
Maya Chen: Dropped a refreshed hero + mode module (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) into staging. Need quick takes for launch assets.
Oliver Park: Reading now. Do we have a single metric to prioritize? Demo requests vs trial starts?
Maya Chen: Demo requests > trial starts > webinar regs. Demo leads for Dedicated/Private should hit AEs.
Priya Kaur: Two CTAs visible: "Request demo" (AE) and "Start free trial" (self-serve). Add a checkbox "I need dedicated/private deployment" to auto-flag AE routing.
Sam R: Swap "predictable throughput" in hero to something clearer: "consistent performance you can rely on". Shorten where possible.
Jordan: Webinar landing should tease benchmarks: "Live: latency & cost comparisons across deployment modes." Add anchor link from hero to benchmarks.
Luis: Routing rules: if checkbox checked OR company_size > 200 => tag enterprise => AE queue. I'll wire Zap + Slack alert. :gear: 
Maya Chen: Tiny form handler for routing: ```
if (form.needsAE || form.companySize>200) routeTo('ae_queue'); else routeTo('nurture');
```
Oliver Park: Add UTMs: utm_medium=web utm_campaign=launch_q2 utm_content=hero_v1
Priya Kaur: I'll draft webinar email + 3 social posts (announce, reminder, day-of) with benchmark snippet.
Sam R: A/B: hero v1 (benefit-led) vs v2 (feature-led) for 7 days. Primary readout: demo CTA CTR and demo form conversions.
launch-bot: Reminder set for 2024-05-02 10:00 UTC "Lock site copy for launch" :bell:
Maya Chen: Thanks all 680 I'll apply edits and ping when staging is updated.
